column1: # The game's lighting at four captured moments, read from retail memory (pc-v10 addresses).
# Each row is the light block the game builds every frame for its renderer (`FUN_00465630`, at
# 0x018C2190) and two fields of the live atmosphere struct S = *(*(0x00E7ADFC) + 0x104):
#   time       S+0x10   the time of day, 0..1 across the day
#   sun_*      S+0x20   the unit direction toward the sun, game axes (Y up); the block's row 0 is its negation
#   light_*    row 1    the directional light's colour, light intensity folded in (= S+0x40)
#   rim_*      row 2    the rim colour (= S+0x110)
#   face<n>_*  rows 3-8 the six ambient faces: ambient cube face n x ambient colour (S+0x80+16n x S+0x70)
#   mie_g      S+0x120  the Henyey-Greenstein constant of the sky's Mie phase function (fScatterHGg)
# Which direction each ambient face lights is not read from the shaders.
# capture: the file under game-files/memory-dumps/ and the first 8 hex digits of its sha256.
#   time_0.10  updated-chris-exports/20261103_new-game-first-mission-start.dmp  c0c96bca
